description: User-sigchain device key binding (#2496; spec 2026-11-25-v2-device-linking-and-recovery §5-§6): device_kem, device_add with its possession signature (pop), and the refusals a verifier must make. Every case is opened with genesis_device_set over its chains (the migration-genesis device set, which verifies every chain and refuses cross-user key reuse); a negative names the closed rejection code. pop = Ed25519(device, utf8(L_DEVICE_POP) || 0x00 || SHA-256(lp(utf8(user)) || lp(signingPk) || lp(encryptionPk) || u16be(format))), lp = u16be length prefix. Format 2 = X-Wing (draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-06).
